name: Jakpack
description: Jakpack's talent is outstanding for a monster of his age. His parents started suspecting that he was special when, at the age of 2, he turned his crib into a hovercraft. He goes to school with all the other young monsters, but he had to combine his education with superhero duty!

skillset.name: Jakpack Taser
skillset.description: Deals moderate Thunder damage to one enemy. Applies Shock to one enemy.

skillset.name: Hero Apprentice
skillset.description: Applies Damage Boost to one ally.

skillset.name: I'll distract him!
skillset.description: Applies Double Damage to one ally. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: Taser Throw
skillset.description: Applies Shock to one enemy. Gives 1 extra turn to itself. Requires cooldown

skillset.name: Found the weakspot
skillset.description: Deals heavy Thunder damage to one enemy. Applies Damage Boost to all allies. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: Come fly with me
skillset.description: Removes all negative status effects from one ally. Restores all cooldowns on all allies. Applies Precision to all allies. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: Flying Taser
skillset.description: Deals moderate Thunder damage to all enemies. Applies shock to all enemies. Requires cooldown.

skillset.name: Jakpack Pack
skillset.description: Restores all cooldowns on all allies. Applies Cooldown Protection and Precision to all allies. Requires cooldown.

ult-ability.name: We're the Patrol
ult-ability.ult-description: Restores all cooldowns on all allies. Removes all Negative Status Effects and gives 100% Life and Stamina to all allies
